defaults.video_script: Ronaldo cried at the World Cup. Morocco had just beaten Portugal, one-nil. En-Nesyri headed it in, forty-second minute. Ronaldo came on after the break. Portugal never found an equaliser. Morocco even finished with ten men. They became Africa's first World Cup semi-finalists. Ronaldo, thirty-seven, in his fifth World Cup. His World Cup dream ended that night. He left the pitch immediately, crying. One header ended Ronaldo's Qatar campaign. Underdog glory, or Ronaldo's biggest heartbreak?
defaults.video_subject: On 10 December 2022 at Al Thumama Stadium Morocco beat Portugal 1-0 in the World Cup quarter-final, Youssef En-Nesyri heading the 42nd-minute goal, becoming the first African team in a World Cup semi-final, while Cristiano Ronaldo, a 51st-minute substitute, left the pitch in tears.
